title: I'm developing a game where you go from street runner to universal god of speed
author: hirikokihiro
selftext:
[https://muwebdev.itch.io/running-god](https://muwebdev.itch.io/running-god)   
Its an incremental idle game focused on you becoming fast as F

Please let me know what you think and any feedback! 

Thank you all

Models and Textures and Translations are all made by using gen ai.
